<thought>Using the most intense peak (m/z 179.0946) as the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈179.0946 − 1.0073 = 178.0873 Da. The formula that matches this mass best is C₇H₁₄O₅ (exact mass = 178.0841 Da, within a few millidaltons of the observed value). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C7H14O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H14O5</final_answer>
